body:
From your Game rules (big-needs pets, animal license).
1. Locked pen: a 🔒 sign on a stake, like the locked garden pots.
2. Sign and tap button name the first missing thing: Pet care level, pet yard level, home, license.
   e.g. 🔒 Pet yard level 3 · 🔒 Animal license 3
3. Tap: Ms. Paws says it in one line, one step at a time.
4. The word "exotic" never appears.
Picture: a test pen. The monkey pen and model come later.

comments.text: Approved: you decided it in chat (31 Oct). Picture for reference.
